THE SCALE IS KEYED TO A PLANNING NUMBER, NOT TO WHAT IS PLACED. CENSUS_SCALE = 576/world.enemy_census, and enemy_census = 1230 is RI-WLD07's plan. 269 bodies are placed. THE CLASS WAS NAMED AND NOT FIXED — C4, MEASURED. loadState('<named>') -> applyNamedState() -> sim.reset() empties sim.entities and the engine re-seeds stealth and population beside it for exactly this reason. It does NOT re-seed sim.souls. Measured: the same untagged fight paid +384, then +0 across the boundary with the same eids and 12 refused re-arms and zero rests. sim.souls.reset() through the back door restores +384; a unique tag restores +384. Round 2 fixed its own instrument with tags; the class fix is one line at the boundary, next to two identical lines already there.

AND THE ROUND-1 CRITIC'S TOOL IS ALREADY DAMAGED. THE GATE'S OTHER EDGE — C5, MEASURED, AND THE LIVE ONE. world/population.js marks a post CLEARED only when EVERY body is down (step 2), releases anything past release_radius as DORMANT (step 3) and re-materialises DORMANT posts with { tag: p.id } (step 4) — a stable tag, so the same eids. A partly-cleared post therefore comes back with its corpses' eids on LIVE, full-HP, hostile bodies. Measured: killed 5 of 6, paid +320; released; returned under the same tag; 6 alive, 5 of them recycled; killing those 5 live hostiles paid +0, while the sixth — never killed before — paid +64. RI-PRG06 §4's row is 'Respawned enemy x1.00'; this is x0.00.

METHOD 6 HAS NO INSTRUMENT AND THE ITEM FAILS IT 5/5. §2's stated purpose is bands 'deliberately non-overlapping at the edges'; method 6 caps adjacent trash-band overlap at 25% of the lower band's width. Measured from §2 as published: R1/R2 32.3%, R2/R3 50.0%, R3/R4 53.3%, R4/R5 76.1%, R5/R6 70.0%. Scale-invariant, so §7 neither causes nor cures it.
